events.title: Localization Update – Bringing Grove to More Players
events.summary: Hello everyone!I wanted to share a quick development update. Alongside continuing work on the full release of Grove of the Seven Stones, I've also begun working on localizing the game into additional languages.The first languages currently in development are German, Russian, Chinese. They are being translated as the game is being developed. events.title: Surprise! The Grove of the Seven Stones demo is available now!
events.summary: I originally planned to release it on July 6th, but after wrapping up the final polish, I decided not to keep everyone waiting.If you love classic CRPGs like Might & Magic, Wizardry, and Ultima, I'd love for you to give it a try.Every bit of feedback helps make the full game even better.Download the demo, explore the Grove, and if you enjoy it, please consider adding the game to your Wishlist.Thank you for all the support!— Mystic Dream Studios

events.title: Grove of the Seven Stones Development Update

events.title: Official Demo Release
events.summary: Hello everyone!I’m excited to announce that the official demo for Grove of the Seven Stones will be released on July 6th.As many of you know, my first game was The Traveller Tale. While I’m proud of what I accomplished with my first release, I also learned a tremendous amount from that experience.
